sourceClarifications: Exercise22.33 surface I is at x=0 with outward normal +x. The slab extends toward negative x. Flux is +750 and the opposite-face field is +577 N/C.
VP22.10.2 is 2.40 microN from the stated data. The printed answer is 2.42 microN; the extracted mN is an OCR representation of microN.
VP22.12.4 inner-surface charge is -4.00 nC. The printed chapter answer has the wrong sign (+4.00 nC).
MCAT22.63 choice (c) is -80 microC, not milliC.
Exercise22.46 historical note gives 1910, while Rutherford's original nuclear-atom paper is dated 1911. Primary source: https://personal.math.ubc.ca/~cass/rutherford/rutherford669.html
Magnitude-only field measurements do not determine the sign of charge; the relevant solutions state this explicitly.
